TRIP STYLE

Bank & wade

Reach the water from shore or by wading. Access rights, footing, depth and current set the practical limits.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who prefer to stay close to shore or explore a short stretch on foot.

Boats & gear

Choose footwear, clothing and tackle for the water. Ask whether waders or a wading staff are appropriate for the exact reach.

Seasons

Water level and temperature affect access. Confirm the route and conditions, even within a documented seasonal window.
